description:
Roles: 
 • The Software Quality Engineer Engineer will work with a small team and will be responsible for writing software automation test code using Selenium for a backlog of existing client applications.
 Key responsibilities/essential functions include:  

 • Implement automation design and execution of functional, regression, integration and scalability tests employing reusable components.
 • Debugging and modifying automation scripts as the target application changes. 
 • Working with development engineers to encourage coding that supports automation. Working with existing QA Engineers to prioritize automation projects and processes
 


 Required Qualifications:  

 • Must have experience using Selenium, this is MUST HAVE! 
 • Must have functional/performance testing experience 
 • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related computer field or Bachelor's Degree and 6 years of experience within technical discipline
 • 5+ years software or hardware testing experience, software development, software Support.
 • 3-5 years test automation experience 
 • Design/develop effective robust test automation. 
 • Design/develop effective non-functional testing (performance, load, limit, concurrency, long-running...)
 • Integrate automation with CI/CD solution. 
 • Increase team velocity. 
 • Apply SDLC principles related to Agile. 
 • Extensive experience team-based environment and collaborative behavior.

 To get further details or to apply for this position please contact:
